content:
Building a PC is a great experience, but you'll need a toolbox full of gear to get the job done right, or at least a small collection if you want things to go as smoothly as possible. And this Black Friday Deals season is one of the best times to update or flesh out your building kit for less.

We've scoured the internet and found the best tools for maintaining your PC. Luckily, these products can be found for affordable prices during Black Friday, if you know where to look. Below, we've broken the tools down into categories, and you can use the navigation link to go directly to the deals that you want.

Quick Links: Best Black Friday Tool Deals

Save 20% on the best thermal paste we've tested, Thermal Grizzly's Duronaut

Save on Hoto's latest electric PixelDrive screwdriver, now $59 🔥

Blow away all the dust and grime with the Wolfbox MF100 high-powered air duster (33% off)

Screwdrivers and Hand Tools

Complete Master Workstation Set: was $89.99 now $59.99
This Hoto workstation set is the go-to kit for on-the-go DIYers, PC builders, and hobbyists. It comes in a magnetic case which helps to organize 26 different steel precision kits, six spudgets, five opening picks, two tweezers, a suction cup, and a pry knife.

You're also getting a magnetic pad, anti-static wrist strap, along with demagnetizing and magnetizing zones. It comes with an electric driver with a 350 mAh battery, rechargeable using USB-C, that's ultra-slim and porable. View Deal

NEX O1 PRO 3.6V Screwdriver Set: was $49.99 now $28.48
HOTO's wireless screwdriver has three torque settings, charges over USB-C, and looks surprisingly good. This kit comes with a sturdy box and all the bits you will need to keep your PC running. View Deal

144-in-1 Electric Screwdriver Set: was $39.99 now $33.99
This 144-in-1 electric precision screwdriver set comes with 120 magnetic bits and 22 repair tools for various disassembly and maintenance tasks, along with a precision screwdriver and electric driver for your PC building and hobbyist repairs. View Deal

25-in-1 Mini Electric Screwdriver: was $39.99 now $29.99
A go-to screwdriver set for the office, workshop, and your go-bag. With all the bits you will need to fix a multitude of problems. View Deal

E2 Ultra Electric Screwdriver: was $79.99 now $49.99
All-time low price.

Get a great deal on this electric screwdriver from Fanttik. The E2 Ultra comes with 50 magnetic bits, and supplies maximum torque of up to 0.6N.m and 270 RPM. The 800mAh battery lasts over 2x longer than the E1 max (charges via USB-C). Get this deal while it lasts. View Deal

500-Piece Computer Screw Kit: was $9.99 now $7.99
This is a large kit of PC screws you'll need for every eventuality. The M.2 SSD screws in particular are handy to have extras of. View Deal

400-Piece Computer Screw Kit: $8.39
With ten different types of screws, stand-offs and gaskets, this kit has everything you need to secure your precious components inside your PC. View Deal

Premium Subcription with Ad Free: $29
Don’t miss out on this Tom’s Hardware Premium. Get a full year of access for just $29, or from $7 per-month. Get an ad-free experience across the site, daily news analysis, deep dives into specialist topics in the semiconductor industry, as well as access to Bench, the largest benchmarking database around. View Deal

Mako Driver Kit: was $39.95 now $33.96
The iFixit range of tools are excellent, and this 53-piece precision driver kit is well worth the splurge!

In the kit you get 4mm bits for common screw types (Phillips, Slot, Pozidrive) and some uncommon such as Petalobe and security Torx. There are even bits to take apart old consoles which often used exotic screws to keep us out!

All of the kit is contained inside a magnetically sealed case, with the lid acting as a magnetic screw sorter enabling us to keep track of which screw goes where! View Deal

Manta: was $69.95 now $59.46
All the bits that you need to take a PC apart, build IKEA furniture or fix that cabinet door that you promised to fix in 2018!

A great mix of precision 4mm bits for general electronics and small projects, and 1/4 inch bits for the larger jobs. You get drivers for both sizes and the same magnetic case as the Make, to prevent losing screws as you take things apart! View Deal

24 in 1 Multi Bit Mini Screwdriver Set: was $19.99 now $13.99
Sleek, compact, and with 24 double-ended bits crammed inside, the Hoto 23-in-1 precision screwdriver should be in your PC building toolkit. Available in slate grey, dark turquoise, and cinnabar red. View Deal

142-Piece Electronics Precision Screwdriver Set: was $37.99 now $23.79
Torx, Slot, Phillips, Pozi, Hex, and many other obscure bits are included in this great set. Spudgers, picks, cleaning cloths, brushes, and tweezers are all wrapped up in a travel case, ready for the next fix. View Deal

64 Piece Electronics Toolkit: was $9.99 now $8.49
This small kit has all the tools to get you started with your first/next PC build. You get a precision screwdriver with 48 different bits (slot, Phillips, Pozidrive, Petalobe, Tork, Stand-off driver, Gamebit (for Nintendo consoles), Torx / Torx security, and many others. You also get spudgers and pry tools, tweezers, a brush, and a magnetizer/demagnetizer for your screwdriver bits. View Deal

13-piece Phillips magnetic long extension set: was $14.99 now $12.74
If you like using a rechargeable screwdriver or one with standard quarter-inch hex shanks, this long six-inch Phillips set is handy for installing air coolers, or when you don't want to have to lean all the way into your case to install things like motherboard screws. They're magnetic to help you from losing screws, and the company claims they're made of tougher steel than some alternatives. View Deal

4-Piece 12-inch Long Screwdriver Set Slotted and Phillips, Long & Short Magnetic Screwdriver Set: was $8.99 now $7.19
Because we always need more screwdrivers, especially long ones with magnetic ends. If you have an air cooler, these are often essential for installation. View Deal

Flush Cutters: was $7.49 now $6.37
Trim, cut, and rip plastic and soft metal from places where it shouldn’t be. Use these cutters to trim electronic components or for other craft projects. View Deal

49-in-1 Precision Screwdriver Set: $5.49
All the bits that you will ever need to keep your tech running smoothly, and you get a great case to keep them all in. View Deal

Electric and Power Hand Tools

16V Brushless Power Drill: was $99.99 now $84.99
This Hoto 16V cordless drill delivers 50 newton-meter torque, with dual high-speed modes providing between 400 and 1,700 RPM for drilling and driving. It's fully rechargeable, with a 1,900 mAh battery. It comes with 10 screwdriver bits, two metal drill bits, three woodworking bits, a multi-purpose ceramic bit, and an extension rod with storage. View Deal

Hobbyists and makers will want to get a hold of this Hoto 35-in-1 cordless rotary tool kit. The rotary tool itself is fitted with a high speed motor, offering five speed modes between 5,000 and 25,000 RPM. You can use this for sanding, polishing, cutting, carving, as well as to finish off a 3D printed model. It's battery operated, using USB-C for charging, and has a full array of attachments for various roles. View Deal

PixelDrive Electric Screwdriver: was $79.99 now $59.99
The latest Hoto electric screwdriver now has a healthy 13% off the MSRP, assuming you're an Amazon Prime Member. View Deal

25-in-1 Mini Electric Screwdriver: was $39.99 now $29.99
A go-to screwdriver set for the office, workshop, and your go-bag. With all the bits you will need to fix a multitude of problems. View Deal

T1 Max Soldering Iron Kit: was $79.99 now $53.19
A great kit to start your soldering journey. The cordless design makes it easy to use, with no trailing wires. The kit includes everything you need to start soldering, making it the ideal soldering gift. View Deal

Components and Consumables

MX-6 Kit: $9.59
This kit contains 4G of Arctic MX-6 thermal paste and six MX Cleaner wipes to remove old thermal paste from components. View Deal

MX-7 4g: was $16.99 now $9.59
Save big on the latest thermal paste from Arctic. Snag a 4g tube of MX-7 on the cheap right now. View Deal

Duronaut (6 grams): was $24.99 now $19.99
The best thermal paste we've tested, this Duronaut kit comes with 6 gams of paste, multiple applicators, and 12 wipes to make the process clean, easy, and effective. It's a great way to keep the temps of your hardware under control. View Deal

Thermal Grizzly's TG Putty Advance is a flexible replacement for classic thermal pads with excellent conductivity. Designed to fill larger gaps, it's good for VRMs and video cards. Basically anything where thermal pads were, this putty can go. View Deal

TF9 2.9g Thermal Paste: $6.09
This paste comes in third in our best thermal paste guide. In our review, we noted that it has excellent thermal performance and great stability. This paste is easy to use and clean up when reapplication is required. View Deal

Flashlights

E7 Rechargeable Mini Flashlight: was $29.99 now $22.78
With USB Type-C charging, six brightness modes, and a magnetic base, the Wuben E7 is a useful flashlight for makers and tinkerers who want extra light for their work, without compromising on quality. View Deal

IMINI 2 Flashlight: was $19.99 now $11.99
This compact and easy to use flashlight provides 50 Lumens of light, without the need to fiddle around for a button. Just unclip, and your flashlight is ready to light your way. View Deal

Rechargable Flashlight: was $25.99 now $16.99
Everyone needs a flashlight for an emergency (or in those tough-to-reach spaces). This Hoto model is rechargeable over USB-C and comes with up to 24 hours of battery life, thanks to its 1,500 mAh battery. Brightness provided is up to 280 Lumens, and it's waterproof, with an IP55 rating. View Deal

Cleaning Tools

Isopropyl Alcohol 99.9%: was $34.95 now $27.96
Buying in bulk and decanting into dollar store spray bottles is the smart way to get all the IPA that you need, and this big bottle will help you stay stocked up for ages. View Deal

99% Isopropyl Alcohol (32 Oz): was $17.99 now $14.39
Sometimes you don't need a gallon of rubbing alcohol and this deal gives you 32 OZ of 99% on sale. View Deal

BLOWZER X6 Jet Powered Air Duster: was $69.99 now $59.49
If you clip the coupon, you can snag this blower for its lowest-ever price. The Blowzer X6 feels more premium than no-name alternatives. And its carrying case for its many accessories makes storing and using the device a lot more convenient. View Deal

MF100 Electric Air Duster: was $89.99 now $59.99
This compact air duster can move air at up to 45 m/s with its 150,000 RPM turbofan. A rechargeable battery gives up to 100 minutes of use time and supports USB Type-C charging. The MF100 includes five nozzles and two brush tools to help clean your PC equipment. View Deal

MF50 Compressed Air Duster: was $39.99 now $29.06
A great price for your own infinite supply of compressed air. View Deal

Electronics Duster x6: was $50.29 now $26.24
Designed for electronics, these six, 10oz bottle of compressed air will blow the dust, dead skin and last week's sandwich from your keyboard and help prevent the inside of your PC case becoming a biohazard. View Deal

AutoCare Air Duster and Electric Screwdriver Kit: was $129.98 now $103.98
This combo deal features the Hoto NEX O1 Pro, a magnetic precision screwdriver powered by a 1,500 mAh battery that will drive over 1,000 screws on a single USB-C charge. It also includes the Hoto AutoCare 4-in-1 air duster and vacuum cleaner with five accessories. View Deal

Handheld Car Vacuum Cleaner: was $79.99 now $59.99
